title: 写三句话介绍你的学校
prompt: Write 3 sentences about your school. Use 'There is / There are'.
tips: 先说学校有什么（there is / there are）

title: 写三句话介绍一个朋友
prompt: Write 3 sentences about your best friend. Use 'He is / She is' and 'He likes / She likes'.

title: 写一段话讲上个周末
prompt: Write 5 sentences about last weekend. Use the past tense (went, played, saw, was).

title: 描写一张图
prompt: Describe a picture of a park. Use 'There is / There are', 'is playing', 'are sitting'.
tips: 先说整体（there is a park）
再说人在做什么（is playing / are sitting）
最后说画面给你的感觉

title: 给朋友写一张便条
prompt: Write a short note to a friend: invite him or her to your birthday party. Say when, where and what you will do.
